ai.title: Rename Manicode to Codebuff in web landing and legal pages
ai.summary: Rebrand strings updated from Manicode to Codebuff in `web/src/app/page.tsx`, `privacy-policy/page.tsx`, and `terms-of-service/page.tsx`. Domain references changed from `manicode.ai` to `codebuff.com` and email addresses from `support@manicode.ai` to `support@codebuff.com`. This aligns web surfaces with the new brand identity. Copy-to-clipboard command now reflects `npm install -g Codebuff`.

eli5.text: The installer command you copy to set up the assistant now reads Codebuff instead of the old brand name, and all the public-facing text on the home page, privacy policy, and terms of service now calls the service Codebuff and points to the new web address and support email. Visitors to the website, anyone signing up or reading the legal pages, and people following the install instructions see the new name and links everywhere, with no functional change to how the software works.

ai.title: Update referral form link to codebuff.retool.com
ai.summary: Referral form URL in `web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx` updated from `manicode.retool.com` to `codebuff.retool.com`. Same form ID and email parameter structure retained. Scope limited to web referrals page.

eli5.text: When you click the referral link on the company website, it now opens a form hosted at codebuff.retool.com instead of the old manicode.retool.com address; the form itself looks the same and still carries your email address. This only affects the page for internal referrals, and anyone visiting that page will be pointed to the new link without noticing any difference in how the form works.

ai.title: Rebrand Manicode to Codebuff in docs and web UI
ai.summary: Project name changed from Manicode to Codebuff across README, knowledge files, and web pages. npm install command updated to codebuff. Pricing page links and contact email updated to codebuff.com. Home page feature descriptions rewritten for clarity.

eli5.text: The product has been renamed from Manicode to Codebuff. If you read the project's introductory guides, help documents, or website, you'll see the new name everywhere, and any links to download or contact support point to the Codebuff-branded addresses. The instructions for installing the tool from a terminal now tell you to run 'npm install -b codebuff' instead of 'npm install -b Manicode'. This rename appears to be fully live across the documentation and website as of the latest changes.

ai.title: Add OpenAI predicted outputs to file processing
ai.summary: Refactored `promptOpenAI` to accept an options object, enabling `predictedContent` for OpenAI's prediction feature. `processFileBlock` switched from Claude Haiku to GPT-4o-mini, passing `updatedContent` as predicted output to speed up generation. Updated prompts to avoid markdown code blocks and adjusted response parsing. Added documentation on thorough refactoring practices.

eli5.text: The backend now sends a preview of the expected code result to the AI model before it generates a response, which helps the model produce code changes faster and more consistently. This affects internal file-processing operations and is live now. The system switched from one AI model to another for part of this work, and updated internal prompts to avoid extra formatting that slowed things down.
